relationships.subject: astaxanthin
relationships.evidence_quote: AST activates the phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K)/protein kinase B (Akt) pathway (33)

relationships.subject: PI3K/Akt pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: The PI3K/Akt pathway upregulates the expression of HO-1, NAD(P)H quinone oxidoreductase-1 (NQO-1)

relationships.subject: astaxanthin
relationships.evidence_quote: AST can block excessive NF-κB signaling by downregulating the phosphorylation of IκB-α or increasing the cellular expression of IκB-α mRNA and protein (44)

relationships.subject: astaxanthin
relationships.evidence_quote: treatment using AST can promote nerve cell regeneration and increase gene expression of proteins important for brain recovery, such as glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP), microtubule associated protein 2 (MAP-2), brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) and growth-associated protein 43 (GAP-43)

key_findings: Astaxanthin crosses the blood-brain barrier and acts via Nrf2/HO-1, PI3K/Akt and NF-κB pathways with antioxidant, anti-inflammatory and anti-apoptotic effects.
Review of astaxanthin neuroprotection in AD, PD, ischemia, SAH and ALS, mostly from animal and cell studies.
